result.title: MoGe-4D: Efficient, Flexible, and Unified Dense 4D Reconstruction and Tracking
result.summary: Reconstructing dynamic scenes from RGB video requires reasoning about both 3D geometry and motion across viewpoints, yet existing methods either split reconstruction and tracking into fragmented pipelines or face prohibitive dense spatiotemporal decoding costs. We introduce MoGe-4D, a feed-forward framework that unifies geometry and motion prediction via ordered queries of paired allocentric and egocentric dynamic point maps. Each query maps source pixels to a target time simultaneously in both camera frames, resolving relative camera pose in closed form while flexibly serving depth, dynamic registration, and dense 3D tracking. For efficient dense querying, MoGe-4D decouples scene modeling from query decoding: a high-capacity context encoder caches coarse global spatiotemporal features once, while a lightweight query encoder rapidly decodes dense point maps at flexible resolutions. Furthermore, as supervising dense 4D queries demands continuous 3D correspondences whose raw trajectory storage is prohibitive, we introduce RigIDTrack, a synthetic data pipeline and dataset that compresses surface dynamics into rigidity-regularized affine bodies, recovering exact arbitrary-frame 3D trajectories with $\sim15\%$ storage overhead over RGB-D video. Across diverse benchmarks, MoGe-4D achieves state-of-the-art dense 3D tracking, matches dedicated 3D foundation models in reconstruction, and runs substantially faster than prior 4D baselines.

AI.brief_summary: MoGe-4D 提出前馈框架，用成对的 all-centric 与 ego-centric 动态点图有序查询统一几何与运动预测，并让高容量编码器只缓存一次全局时空特征、由轻量查询解码器按需稠密解码，另构建 RigIDTrack 合成数据与轨迹压缩监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重编码器一次性缓存粗粒度时空特征、轻量查询解码器灵活分辨率稠密读取」的结构，可能可迁移为 LVR 中视觉证据缓存与按需读取、动态计算的组织方式，但原论文面向 4D 重建与跟踪，未涉及推理状态或答案生成，需核查其对应性。
